reason: The preregistered representation uses one-minute decision states with trailing 60-second features. The first TRAIN implementation mistakenly applied 60-row rolling operations after minute aggregation, i.e. approximately 60 minutes.

continuous_and_aggregated.current: last non-null raw observation inside the calendar minute
continuous_and_aggregated.trailing_60s_mean: mean of raw observations inside that calendar minute
continuous_and_aggregated.delta_60s: last non-null minus first non-null raw observation inside that calendar minute

binary_and_operational.current: last non-null raw observation inside the calendar minute
binary_and_operational.changed_within_60s: 1 iff at least two distinct non-null raw values occur inside that calendar minute
